participant_instructions: Answer from the repository at the exact target revision.
Trace the named production entry point and any helpers needed to explain observable control flow, mutations, yielded/returned values, and exceptions.
Support each material claim with an inline citation in the form `relative/path.py:start-end`.
Do not rely on tests, runtime experiments, or prior benchmark answers as a substitute for source reasoning.

tasks.title: Recursive dependency injection
tasks.prompt: Trace `solve_dependencies(...)` end to end. Explain request/function exit-stack requirements and accumulator initialization; recursive subdependency solving and override rebuilding; error propagation and cache-key semantics; how cached, generator, async, and sync callables execute (including generator scope); request parameter and body extraction; injection of request/websocket/background/response/security objects; and the exact contents returned.

tasks.title: Response validation and serialization
tasks.prompt: Trace `serialize_response(...)` for every branch. Explain behavior with and without a response field; event-loop versus threadpool validation; error construction and endpoint context; `dump_json` serializer selection; propagation of include/exclude/alias/default flags; and the fallback encoding path.

tasks.title: Lazy nested router inclusion
tasks.prompt: Trace `APIRouter.include_router(...)` and the helpers that make an included router effective later. Explain direct and indirect cycle rejection; prefix and empty-path validation; how inherited include metadata is combined across nesting; what is appended and invalidated at include time; startup, shutdown, and lifespan merging; lazy route candidate caching/versioning; and how API, WebSocket, Starlette Route/Mount/Host, and nested-router candidates are materialized and matched.
